name: Article publishing schedule with an embargo and a dependency
prompt: Assign three articles (M, N, O) to three publish times (9am, 12pm, 3pm) — each article gets exactly one distinct time. Use the constraints below (no outside assumptions). State your final plan as three lines in exactly this format so it can be checked automatically: 'Task M: <time>', 'Task N: <time>', 'Task O: <time>'.

(2) Article N must publish before Article O, since N sets up context that O references. (3) Each article must be assigned a distinct publish time.
Soft preference: publishing Article O at 3pm is preferred (weight 1), for peak afternoon traffic. No other soft preferences apply.
